test_CompressionConfig_defaults: test the CompressionConfig class returns default values for target_max_tokens, summary_target_tokens, and protect_last_n_turns

test_TrajectoryCompressor_find_protected: test the TrajectoryCompressor identifies protected head and tail turn indices in a conversation trajectory

test_TrajectoryCompressor_count_tokens: test the TrajectoryCompressor counts tokens in text and trajectories using a tokenizer with character-based fallback
